text.title: Close loops, don’t count them
text.synthetic: SYNTHETIC: every row, count and report line in this panel is simulated. No real patient, report or county record.
text.clock: The referral clock starts when the referral is sent (event REFERRAL_SENT), not when it is received.
text.as_of: Replay date: the worklist sees only SYNTHETIC events dated on or before this date.
text.governance: The county owns the list and the care. Nurses call. No patient data leaves the county or goes to any sponsor. Any company role is a documented, non-promotional collaboration owned by the county.
text.legal: Since 1 June 2026 a county may identify patients whose care does not follow recommendations (“joiden hoito ei vastaa suosituksia”); processing their data and contacting them must respect data protection and self-determination (STM, 21 May 2026). Scope for pathway timing to be confirmed with STM/THL.
text.regulatory: A workflow aid: it copies the radiologist's written recommendation, computes a date, and a nurse decides. Device qualification under the MDR to be confirmed with Fimea before the pilot (UNVERIFIED). AI Act high-risk dates 2 Dec 2027 and 2 Aug 2028 tracked.
text.pilot: Pilot: Satakunta, every overdue suspected-cancer referral, lung follow-up first. Chosen on process grounds: Finnish-language services, not under the state assessment procedure, already the default on SAMA’s pilot card (data/roadmap/mapping-v1.json). Not chosen as “highest lung mortality”. Whether Satakunta is in the national lung screening pilot is UNVERIFIED; if it is in a randomised arm, the evaluation design must change.
text.scope: Finnish report lines only; lines in other languages go to manual entry.
text.rule: A code rule reads the follow-up recommendation (no model). It copies the written phrase and computes the due date; ranges, approximate, vague or conditional wording go to a person. A nurse confirms every item.
text.neutrality: Vendor- and product-neutral. No drug or biomarker content.
text.aland: The 1 June 2026 amendment and national measures are not claimed for Åland (separate health legislation; UNVERIFIED).
text.roadmap: Operational form of SAMA’s navigation action (roadmap 1.2.3, named care-coordinating worker) with digital pathways (3.5.3).

thresholds.label: PLACEHOLDER
thresholds.source: Placeholder taken from the OECD/EU-reported six-week referral-to-treatment target (OECD/EU Country Cancer Profile Finland 2025, p. 19; evidence row oecd-2025-six-week-target). The law (STM hoitotakuu) allows up to six months for treatment and names no cancer-specific limit. Not a SAMA decision: cancer-specific access times are to be set under roadmap measure 3.1.2 (p. 57); quality targets and indicators under 3.1.4 (p. 58).

thresholds.label: PLACEHOLDER
thresholds.source: SAMA's navigation action flags a stalled work-up at 90 days, also a placeholder. Shown only as a count, so the two placeholders do not compete.

thresholds.label: COPIED
thresholds.source: The due date the radiologist wrote, copied by the rule and computed by calendar arithmetic. Never decided by SAMA. Ranges and vague wording go to a person.

Stage at diagnosis among people found through the worklist
Every KPI reported by entry route, education and contact language, so the safety net cannot reproduce the gap

suppression.rule: Counts 1-4 are displayed as "<5"; raw SYNTHETIC counts stay in this file. National totals are summed from county rows.

rule.caveat: Measured on 60 SYNTHETIC lines from code templates written by the same step after the rule was frozen; not a result on real reports.

imaging_loops.note: Second check, after the 60-line evaluation: the cohort lines are rendered from the same templates with new seeds and dates, so new combinations of finding and recommendation sentences occur. Same caveat: not real reports.

assumptions.interpreter_flag: set when contact language is other

assumption_notes: Every value in ASSUMPTIONS is a simulation choice made for this demo, not an estimate about Finland.
Imaging follow-up completion (70% on time, 20% late, 10% not done) is the same in every county and route, so the share done by the due date reproduces 0.70 up to sampling noise; it is not a finding.
The imaging cohort reuses the 60-line test family mix (30 dated, 20 for a person, 10 no follow-up per 60); that mix is a design choice, not an observed report mix.
Contact language is drawn from one fixed share for every county; it is not Statistics Finland data.
Age bands of imaging loops are drawn uniformly from 40-44 to 80-84; event-log age bands come from its simulator, which draws them uniformly from 0-4 to 100+.
